## Summary

What changed and why? Link the `ROADMAP.md` item it belongs to, if any.

## Verification

Which commands or manual checks did you run, and what did they print? Name the exact commands (for example `npm run verify`); a count of tests is not evidence.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows [`CONSTITUTION.md`](https://github.com/LeonardSchwier/leotheca/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md) and [`documentation/PROJECT_RULES.md`](https://github.com/LeonardSchwier/leotheca/blob/main/documentation/PROJECT_RULES.md).
- [ ] Tests cover the behaviour, and `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] Documentation is updated, and `master-spec.md` too when application behaviour changed.
- [ ] Commit messages carry the evidence trailers that apply (`Legal-Check:`, `Review:`, `Database-Review:`, `Dependency-intake:`), see [`hooks/README.md`](https://github.com/LeonardSchwier/leotheca/blob/main/hooks/README.md).
- [ ] No telemetry, account requirement, network call or incompatibly licensed dependency was added.
